parsed.name: 函数/任意波形发生器
parsed.description: 这是一台台式函数/任意波形发生器，用于输出可控的正弦波等测试信号，并可进行触发与突发输出设置。它常用于电子电路调试、仪器联调、激励信号注入和实验室通用信号源应用。
parsed.description_en: This is a benchtop function/arbitrary waveform generator used to produce controlled test signals such as sine waves, with support for triggering and burst-style output. It is commonly used for electronic circuit testing, instrument synchronization, stimulus injection, and general laboratory signal-source tasks.

actions.description: 向波形发生器发送原始控制命令。
actions.description_en: Send a raw control command to the waveform generator.

actions.description: 触发波形发生器开始一次触发输出或突发输出。
actions.description_en: Trigger the waveform generator to start a triggered or burst output.

actions.description: 让仪器发出蜂鸣提示音。
actions.description_en: Make the instrument emit a beep.

actions.description: 设置输出波形的频率、幅度和波形类型。
actions.description_en: Configure the output waveform frequency, amplitude, and shape.

actions.description: 设置突发输出模式的循环次数。
actions.description_en: Configure the burst mode cycle count.

actions.description: 设置自由运行突发输出的循环次数和重复速率。
actions.description_en: Configure the free-running burst output cycle count and repetition rate.
